query:
SELECT g.id, g.name
            FROM user_groups g
            JOIN group_members gm ON g.id = gm.group_id
            WHERE gm.user_id = $1 AND g.tenant_id = $2
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM users u
                  WHERE u.id = gm.user_id AND u.tenant_id = $2
              )
